subject: Acadia Health: Marketplace listing / credit exception request
messages:
From: Seth Morales <seth.morales@acadia-health.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: procurements@acadia-health.com
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:30 -0700
Subject: Request: Marketplace credit / price adjustment for pilot

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is excited about Redwood's latency and cost profile for our generative notes pilot. We're moving quickly on procurement, but a couple of things are tripping the marketplace/private-offer path:

- AWS Marketplace requires the listing price to be within a threshold of the catalog SKU; the initial quote is ~40% below internal list, and procurement needs either a formal marketplace credit or an exception.
- We can commit to a 12-month pilot (estimated $120k ARR) and a joint case study, but we need ledgered credits to make the Marketplace PO work with our finance team.

Can Redwood provide a marketplace listing credit or an approved exception so we can accept a Private Offer from AWS? If helpful I attached the PO template our procurement team will issue.

Attachment: Acadia_PO_template.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — Seth

Seth Morales
Director, Digital Transformation
Acadia Health

- I need to escalate to deal desk for a formal marketplace exception / listing credit. I'll include details below about ARR, term, and the use case.
- Ben and Marcus are looped in to ensure we consider co-sell and listing implications.

Could you confirm: 1) exact annual committed spend (is the $120k the committed ARR), 2) whether you need the credit applied to the Marketplace listing price or as a one-time onboarding credit in the Private Offer, and 3) expected go-live date?

If you prefer, we can do a short call Monday to align and I can present the ask to deal desk.

Thanks,
Hannah

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2027 16:35:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Acadia Health — recommended concession for listing approval

Team — quick summary for deal desk intake:

- Account: Acadia Health (regional health system), Related deal: RDW-2027-ACD-1147
- Ask: Approve a marketplace listing credit (or allowed variance) to enable an AWS Private Offer. Acadia is requesting a ~35% placement to match the buyer-approved price in their PO.
- Rationale: 12-month committed pilot, estimated $120k ARR, strong reference potential (national health system), co-sell/marketing commitment (customer case study + 2 joint webinars).
- Risk/guardrails we recommend: limit to first-year effective discount, cap at $42k credit total, require the Private Offer be executed through AWS Marketplace and visible in our console (so billing is through marketplace).
- Suggested approval: listing credit applied as an offset on the private-offer invoice (not a permanent list-price change); require sign-off from marketplace team post-commitment.

I'm attaching the marketplace-exception-approval-form with suggested fields filled. If Jonas can greenlight the variance, Hannah can proceed to the DocuSign and Acadia.

Attachments: marketplace-exception-approval-form.xlsx (xlsx)

Ben Carter
Head of Sales, Marketplace Partnerships
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, AWS Marketplace Partner Team <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Apr 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acadia Health — recommended concession for listing approval

Ben / Hannah — reviewed the details. Approval granted under these conditions:

1) Approve a one-time marketplace credit up to $42,000 (≈35% of the quoted first-year invoice) to be consumed against the first Private Offer invoice.
2) The Private Offer must be processed through AWS Marketplace with Redwood's listing SKU unchanged in the catalog (credit applied on invoice as an exception).
3) Require the customer to sign the attached Marketplace Exception Approval form and the DocuSign Private Offer within 10 business days.
4) Marketing/co-sell commitments must be documented in the HubSpot deal (case study + at least one joint webinar within six months).

I have populated the approval form and flagged the deal in the marketplace queue. Marcus, please coordinate with the marketplace ops team to ensure the credit is ledgered correctly.

Approved by: Jonas Weber — Director, Deal Desk
jonas_weber@redwood.com

Attachment: marketplace-exception-approval-form.xlsx (xlsx)
Related link: https://hubspot.com/deals/42571234

Hi Seth — good news. Jonas has approved a one-time marketplace credit up to $42k so we can proceed with the AWS Private Offer flow. Next steps:

1) I've attached the filled approval form and the Private Offer quote. Please sign the DocuSign here: https://www.docusign.com/embeddedSigning/abc123-acadia
2) Once signed, we'll push the private offer through AWS Marketplace and the credit will be applied to your first invoice.
3) Can we lock a go-live window of May 17? That gives ops time to finalize the SKU and onboarding.

Thanks for the quick turnaround — excited to get this pilot launched and to work on the case study.
